author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy book map designer + character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely does not have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you are a fantasy author recommending someone you have personally worked with. See follow-up posts for details. Character art: prefers realistic, epic fantasy concept art over cartoon illustration; book is lighter fantasy but wants grounded, lifelike art; open to different styles; bonus for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. Portraits for now, more work if the style fits the series. Map: detailed, immersive, classic fantasy-map feel, stylistically open. Contact: reply on the thread or DM. https://www.threads.com/@veliraiyawrites/post/Ddz7KZNCetH

author: Temmycreative
title: Paid vector illustrator for Halloween apparel
content: Looking for a vector illustrator (Paid). Need an illustrator who can create an original 80s-90s Goosebumps-inspired Halloween design for a hoodie/T-shirt. Requirements: one skeleton as the main character; punk/rock retro horror vibe; clean vector for screen printing (AI/SVG/EPS); large back print (13 x 16); neon green, purple and orange palette; original artwork only (no tracing existing designs). Please reply with portfolio, turnaround time, and price. Follow-up: must be an Adobe Illustrator user; please DM if available. https://www.threads.com/@temmycreative_/post/DdzVJUhiFl1
